question: What is the status of the kāma-bīja among all the mantras of Viṣṇu?
premises: The kāma-bīja is present among them.
It is described as higher than the highest.
inference: Among all Viṣṇu mantras, the kāma-bīja is supreme beyond the supreme.
plain_english: Among all Viṣṇu mantras, the kāma-bīja is supreme beyond the supreme.
